title: Anime Wow
blurb: Sparkly-eyed, breathless amazement at absolutely nothing. Anime characters produce this gasp at sunsets, at sandwiches, at the concept of friendship, and that reliability makes it enormously useful once you apply it ironically. Somebody parallel parks adequately? Anime wow. A vending machine returns correct change first time? Anime wow. It supplies cheap awe in unlimited quantities and never runs dry, which is more than sincere enthusiasm manages. Best deployed at the smallest achievement in the room, delivered with a completely straight face.
origin: The classic wide-eyed anime gasp, memed as ironic amazement at nothing.
